name: Seerr (Jellyseerr)
summary: Lets the family ask for movies and shows; approved requests go straight to Radarr and Sonarr.
description:
Seerr (formerly Jellyseerr and Overseerr, now one project) is a friendly place for the family to browse what's popular, see what's already on Jellyfin or Plex, and request new movies and shows. You approve requests (or let trusted people auto-approve) and Seerr hands them to Radarr and Sonarr.

After installing, open Seerr and sign in with your Jellyfin or Plex account; it becomes the Seerr administrator. Then connect Jellyfin or Plex, Radarr and Sonarr under Settings, using http://host.docker.internal:<port> (or this server's address) and each app's API key. Family members sign in with their own Jellyfin or Plex accounts.
